resources.string: Ask about UIT regulations, notices and your academic information. Sign in with UIT; no API key needed.
What would you like to ask UIT?
UMA answers from university sources and the information your UIT account is allowed to view.
Questions go directly to UMA. This conversation stays in app memory; UMA may keep a server-side question log.
UMA needs its own secure session, even if you already signed in to Portal or Moodle.
What are the requirements for an academic encouragement scholarship?
What is my current cumulative GPA?
Are there any new course registration announcements?
Choose sources above. Enable My academic information for personal questions.
UMA is checking its sources… The answer arrives when the request completes.
Stopped on this device. UMA may still finish the request on its server.
The request did not complete. You can reuse the question; it will not be resent automatically.
UMA can be wrong. Check the cited source before an important decision.
Changing sources starts a new conversation on this device, so earlier personal context is not reused.
My academic information lets UMA consult records available to your signed-in UIT account. No local app files or OpenAI credentials are sent.

Requests go only to uma.uit.edu.vn. UIT SSO establishes a separate UMA session, encrypted on this device. Conversations are kept only in process memory and cleared on disconnect, source changes or app process termination. UMA receives the question, selected sources and at most three previous successful turns, with each earlier answer shortened to 200 characters. UMA may record requests on its server. Clearing here does not delete server logs. Source links open in your browser without forwarding app cookies. File uploads, feedback and account changes are not performed.
Clear this conversation from this device? UMA server logs are unaffected.
UMA did not find an accessible source
No classes reported for this week.
Some source details need the UMA website. The text version remains available here.
Cannot reach UMA. Check your connection. No automatic resend was made.
Your UMA session expired. Sign in again to continue.
UMA could not verify the session. Sign in again; your question was not automatically resent.
UMA is limiting requests. Wait before sending another question.
UMA could not complete this request. Try again later.
The UMA response could not be read safely. You can check the UMA website.
The local UMA session could not be saved or loaded. Reconnect UMA.
